head.h1: NYE Party Catering Dubai: Planning Guide
head.meta_description: Plan New Year’s Eve catering in Dubai, from canapés and live stations to midnight service, with venue access and complete pricing confirmed.

opening_paragraph: NYE party catering in Dubai should follow the shape of your evening: arrivals, the main meal, the countdown and the time guests leave. Choose a menu that can be served well in your venue, then agree the staffing and timings around those moments.

new_paragraphs: Passed canapés can welcome guests while drinks are served. A buffet, sharing menu or live station can provide the main food, followed by a dessert or smaller late-evening selection. The quantities should reflect how long the party lasts and whether guests expect a complete dinner.

Agree when food service pauses, where guests gather and what is included for midnight. Any drinks service must be appropriate for the venue and confirmed in writing. Keep access routes and service areas clear as guests move around the space.

New Year’s Eve can involve busy roads and restricted building or marina access. Confirm the venue’s instructions, delivery windows and staff departure arrangements before the final plan is issued. If the event is on a yacht, include the operator and captain in the timing discussion.

Canapés, BBQ and live stations start from AED 150 per person at myCHEF, while bespoke plated dining is AED 700–950. The actual New Year’s Eve quote depends on availability, duration, staffing and venue requirements. Ask which extras, overtime and taxes apply to your date.

Compare the complete service, including the menu, guest count, preparation, staffing, equipment, delivery and clear-down. A per-person price is useful only when the inclusions are clear. Ask which elements are fixed and which can change if your plans change.

Share allergies and other dietary requirements before confirming. The culinary partner should explain the preparation arrangements and any remaining cross-contact risk. Review the payment schedule, cancellation terms and change deadlines in your written booking.

Send the date, Dubai address, expected guest count and preferred service time, together with your menu ideas and venue details. Photos of the kitchen or service area can help the team assess what is practical.

myCHEF typically replies within 15 minutes between 9am and 11pm Dubai time. The tailored proposal follows once the requirements and availability have been reviewed. A first reply is an acknowledgement, rather than confirmation that a chef or date has been secured.
